title: Tropical Bi-Objective Pseudolinear Optimization as Parametric Mean-Payoff Games
summary: We extend the parametric mean-payoff game framework of Parsons et al. to bi-objective tropical pseudolinear optimization with general two-sided constraints. The problem is to simultaneously minimize two tropical pseudolinear objectives over the feasible set of a general two-sided system U otimes x oplus b is less than or equal to V otimes x oplus d, we characterize the Pareto front via a parametric mean-payoff game in two parameters ( lambda 1, lambda 2).
